opportunity_name: Acme Corp Web & API Security Vulnerability Assessment & Penetration Test
rfp_text: Acme Corporation requires a comprehensive Vulnerability Assessment and Penetration Test (VAPT) across our customer-facing web portal and microservice REST APIs. Scope includes OWASP Top 10 vulnerabilities, authentication bypass testing, business logic flaw review, and external infrastructure scanning. Testing must be completed within a 3-week window with formal re-testing included.
